Plus announcements that fill themselves in, Gemini voices, and Yaxxa AI PBX as a plan feature.

GOOD TO KNOW

Nothing changes until you use it. Products, customer lists and tags are there to set up; separate clients is a plan feature that is off unless an operator or reseller switches it on.

Words that changed: imported leads are now "Campaign lists", and your own customer base is "Customer lists". Nothing that connects through the API changes.

Installing: the new database indexes are built alongside normal traffic, so calls and messages keep being recorded while the update installs, however long the history.

Not yet proven with a real account: Gemini voices (built from Google's published Cloud Text-to-Speech guide; needs a Google Cloud project and a service account).

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

Products: define what your customers hold under Customers → Products and fields, or start from a ready-made set for your industry (fibre, LTE, mobile, hosted voice, printer leases, funeral, life, vehicle and home cover, arrears, payment arrangements, solar, utilities, subscriptions, warranties and more). Each product has a status, dates, a reference and its own fields, and can be imported or built from BMS equipment.

Customer fields and tags: your own fields on customers (with privacy settings), and tags for quick grouping.

Customer lists: fixed lists, and smart lists that keep themselves up to date, for example "Fibre contracts ending in 60 days" or "Arrears over 90 days". Preview, count, export and tag everyone on a list.

Lists put to work: a campaign can call customer lists and stays in step as people join, leave or opt out, never dialling anyone twice. Journeys and broadcasts can use them too, and Create work for everyone makes a ticket, a callback or a BMS callout for each person on a list.

Routing by product: a flow step "Customer has product", and queue rules that add a skill or move the work for customers who hold a product.

Separate clients (a plan feature): for organisations that run work for several companies. Customers, lists, campaigns, queues, messaging channels, tickets and conversations belong to a client, and agents and teams are assigned to clients. Agents only see, search and receive their own clients' work; a client's WhatsApp, SMS, email or web chat only matches and creates that client's customers; supervisors can narrow any screen to one client. It is enforced in the database itself.

Phone system permissions: for organisations whose plan includes Yaxxa AI PBX, two new permissions, "See the phone system" (extensions, numbers, call flows, phones and reports) and "Set up the phone system" (the same, plus AI and security). Organisation administrators hold both and auditors can see.

Voices: Gemini (Google) is a new voice service, and any connected voice service can be made the default. When the default is busy or failing, the next one speaks instead.

FOR PLATFORM OPERATORS AND RESELLERS

Announcements that fill themselves in: Draft from the release notes gives the real highlights per audience; maintenance notices fill the window in each tenant's time zone and can announce a pending update; incident notices take the current state and have update and resolved follow-ups; placeholders fill each tenant's own name and contact. Preview as any tenant and role before sending.

Separate clients is switched on per plan, like the other opt-in features.

Yaxxa AI PBX is a new opt-in plan feature, "Yaxxa AI PBX: the hosted phone system". It is off for every organisation until you switch it on in the plan.

FIXES

Agents can change their not-ready reason directly, for example from signing in to Break, and the timer restarts for the new reason. Adherence now looks at the reason: during a scheduled break,"}
